name: Shane Leydon
bio: Shane Leydon is a Métis, Irish and Mennonite actor from Treaty 5 Territory in Flin Flon, Manitoba. He is known for bringing grounded intensity, physical presence and emotional clarity to the screen and stage as a performer. He is developing several projects set in Western Canada as a writer/director with his production company, Red Deer Hill Films, which is named after the Métis community his ancestors call home, South of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan.

credits.title: A Free Man
credits.overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

credits.title: Famous Last Words
credits.overview: Delusional actors Donnie and Gwen strive for fame in the bizarre Vancouver film industry.
